thread:
maria g: Heads up — saw the console clipboard/preview show a snippet from a different workspace after I quick-switched orgs. Steps to repro below.

maria g: 1) Open workspace A, copy a large query snippet into the console preview.
2) Quick-switch to workspace B (keyboard shortcut).
3) Open quick-preview panel — it shows the snippet from A for ~2s before repaint.

maria g: Screenshots attached in thread (not included here).

alex k: repro'd on my machine :confused: same behavior. macOS, Chrome. Can you paste any console logs?

maria g: here's the small console dump I grabbed:```
INFO: preview.render start workspace=B lastClipboardId=cs-8a7f
INFO: preview.fetch lastClipboardOrg=null cachedItem=cs-8a7f
WARN: preview.hydrate used fallback cache (no org key)
```

samir r: sounds like the client-side clipboard cache is being stored without an org/workspace prefix. If we store in localStorage under `clipboard:last` it will bleed across orgs when switching fast.

samir r: quick fix: prefix keys with `org:{orgId}:clipboard:last` and ensure the preview read path uses the current orgId before hydrating. Also add a short debounce on workspace-switch to force cache invalidation.

ops-jen: agreed we should treat as a P1-ish data isolation bug for the console. It exposes other org content briefly. Any telemetry yet?

samir r: not currently. We should emit a telemetry event `console.clipboard_preview.cache_miss` and a high-severity `console.clipboard_preview.cross_org_visible` when preview renders and `lastClipboardOrg != currentOrg`.

alex k: I can take the patch. Plan: add org-prefixed keys, invalidate cache on workspace switch, add unit for key derivation, and emit the telemetry events. Will open PR later today.

maria g: thanks. also test on Firefox — the behaviour was slightly different there (harder to catch but present).

console-bot: Deploy check: no active console canaries right now. Recommend canary rollout for this change once PR passes CI.

ops-jen: add an entry to the rollouts board and mark canary target = 5% of prod users for 24h. Coordinate with support in case any customers report UI glitches.

alex k: filed PR #4021 with the key prefix and telemetry. Added a short e2e that switches orgs and asserts preview is empty for the new org.

samir r: I'll review the PR and add a small integration test for localStorage migration (old keys -> new keys) so we don't regress.

maria g: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) add dashboard widget under "console > incidents" to show any `console.clipboard_preview.cross_org_visible` events, (2) postmortem if we find actual customer exposure.

ops-jen: created ticket INC-789 for tracking and a dashboard tile request. Please add links in the PR.

alex k: will do. ping me if you want to triage telemetry alerts while I wait on reviews. :thumbsup:

maria g: appreciated. I'll keep an eye on support and flag anything. :eyes:
